installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

## File: Pterodactyl Arma Reforger Egg - egg-pterodactyl-arma-reforger.json
## Author: David Wolfe (Red-Thirten)
## Date: 2024/07/03
## License: MIT License
## Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/ptero-eggs/installers:debian'

## Download and install SteamCMD
export HOME=/mnt/server
cd /tmp
mkdir -p $HOME/steamcmd $HOME/steamapps
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C $HOME/steamcmd
cd $HOME/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
chown -R root:root /mnt

# Install/Verify game server using SteamCMD
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir $HOME +login anonymous $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} +app_update 1007 $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit

# Set up 32 and 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk{32,64}
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Arma Reforger setup
# Check for successful installation
if [[ ! -f $HOME/ArmaReforgerServer ]]; then
    echo -e "\n\nSteamCMD failed to install the Arma Reforger Dedicated Server!"
    echo -e "\tTry reinstalling the server again.\n"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p $HOME/profile $HOME/tmp

echo -e 'Creating default "config.json" configuration file...'
# Build the "admins" JSON array from a comma-separated list of SteamID64s
ADMIN_JSON=""
if [[ -n "${ADMIN_IDS}" ]]; then
    IFS=',' read -ra ADMIN_ARR <<< "${ADMIN_IDS}"
    for id in "${ADMIN_ARR[@]}"; do
        id="$(echo -n "$id" | xargs)"
        [[ -z "$id" ]] && continue
        ADMIN_JSON="${ADMIN_JSON}${ADMIN_JSON:+,}\"${id}\""
    done
fi

cat > $HOME/config.json << EOF
{
	"bindAddress": "0.0.0.0",
	"bindPort": ${SERVER_PORT},
	"publicAddress": "${SERVER_IP}",
	"publicPort": ${SERVER_PORT},
	"game": {
		"name": "${SERVER_NAME}",
		"password": "${SERVER_PASS}",
		"passwordAdmin": "${ADMIN_PASS}",
		"admins": [${ADMIN_JSON}],
		"scenarioId": "${SCENARIO_ID}",
		"maxPlayers": ${MAX_PLAYERS},
		"visible": ${VISIBLE},
		"autoJoinable": ${AUTO_JOINABLE},
		"gameProperties": {
			"serverMaxViewDistance": ${VIEW_DISTANCE},
			"serverMinGrassDistance": ${GRASS_DISTANCE},
			"networkViewDistance": ${NETWORK_VIEW_DISTANCE},
			"disableThirdPerson": ${DISABLE_THIRD},
			"fastValidation": true,
			"battlEye": ${BATTLEYE},
			"VONDisableUI": ${VON_DISABLE_UI},
			"VONDisableDirectSpeechUI": ${VON_DISABLE_DIRECT_UI}
		},
		"mods": []
	},
	"operating": {
		"playerSaveTime": ${PLAYER_SAVE_TIME},
		"aiLimit": ${AI_LIMIT},
		"disableServerShutdown": ${DISABLE_SERVER_SHUTDOWN},
		"disableCrashReporter": ${DISABLE_CRASH_REPORTER}
	}
}
EOF

echo -e "\nArma Reforger Dedicated Server successfully installed!\n"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name displayed in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required for clients to enter before they can join the server. Leave empty to have no password.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed to join the server.

variables.name: Scenario ID
variables.description: ID of scenario to run/play. Valid IDs can be viewed in the console upon startup of the server.

variables.name: Visible in Server Browser
variables.description: Set the visibility of the server in the Server Browser.

variables.name: Auto Joinable
variables.description: Set if the session can be selected through the auto join feature.

variables.name: Server Region
variables.description: Region listed in the server browser. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes can be used in this field.

variables.name: [Admin] Admin Password
variables.description: Password that grants a connecting client in-game admin/moderation rights.

variables.name: [Admin] Admin SteamID64s
variables.description: Comma-separated list of SteamID64s to grant persistent server admin rights to (independent of the admin password). Only applied on install/reinstall.

variables.name: [Gameplay] Enable BattlEye
variables.description: Enables the anti-cheat engine on the server and requires all clients to be running it.

variables.name: [Gameplay] Disable Third Person
variables.description: Forces first-person only view for all players.

variables.name: [Voice Chat] Disable Voice UI
variables.description: Hides the in-game voice chat UI indicators.

variables.name: [Voice Chat] Disable Direct Speech UI
variables.description: Hides the in-game direct (proximity) speech UI indicators.

variables.name: [Performance] Max View Distance
variables.description: Maximum terrain/object view distance in meters.

variables.name: [Performance] Min Grass Distance
variables.description: Minimum distance in meters at which grass is rendered for all clients.

variables.name: [Performance] Network View Distance
variables.description: Maximum distance in meters at which entities are network-relevant to clients.

variables.name: [Performance] AI Limit
variables.description: Maximum number of active AI units. -1 for unlimited. Lowering this is one of the most effective ways to reduce server load in AI-heavy scenarios.

variables.name: [Performance] Max FPS
variables.description: Sets a maximum FPS limit for the server, saving performance in some cases. Leave empty for no limit.

variables.name: [Advanced] Player Autosave Interval
variables.description: How often (in seconds) player state is persisted to disk.

variables.name: [Advanced] Disable Server Shutdown
variables.description: Prevents the server from automatically shutting down when it loses its connection to the backend.

variables.name: [Advanced] Disable Crash Reporter
variables.description: Disables the automatic server-side crash report generation/upload.

variables.name: [Advanced] Log FPS Interval
variables.description: How often (in seconds) to log the FPS and other debug stats to the console. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: [Repair] Validate Server Files
variables.description: "true" to enable; empty to disable. Validates all server files when Automatic Updates is enabled. Note: This will significantly increase server startup times, so it is recommended to only enable this when needed.

variables.name: [Updates] Automatic Updates
variables.description: Quickly checks for any server or mod updates on startup, and updates if necessary.

variables.name: [Updates] Arma Reforger Dedicated Server App ID
variables.description: Used for installation and updates. Rarely needs to be changed.
